map.由每股收益与股价求盈利收益率 使用指南: Earnings yield from EPS and share price - User Guide
map.输入每股收益 EPS 与股价，按盈利收益率 = EPS / P 计算，相当于市盈: Enter EPS and share price; earnings yield = EPS / P, the reciprocal of P/E, for cross-comparison of stock earnings return with bond yield.
map.输入每股收益 EPS 与股价 P，求盈利收益率。: Enter EPS and share price P to find earnings yield.
map.E/P 即市盈率的倒数，衡量每元市价对应的盈利。: E/P is the reciprocal of the P/E ratio, measuring earnings per unit of market price.
map.与债券收益率比较（Fed 模型式股债性价比）。: Compare with bond yield (Fed-model style equity-bond attractiveness).
map.价值股筛选（高 E/P 相对便宜）。: Value-stock screening (high E/P is relatively cheap).
map.：盈利收益率 = 1/PE = 1/20 = 5%。即每 100 元市值对应 5: : earnings yield = 1/PE = 1/20 = 5%. That is, every 100 CNY of market cap corresponds to 5 CNY annualized earnings.
map.：E/P = 1/15 ≈ 6.67%。比 PE=20 更具盈利性价比（同样价格: : E/P = 1/15 ~ 6.67%. Better earnings value than P/E=20 (more earnings for the same price).
map.盈利收益率和债券收益率比什么？: What does earnings yield compare with bond yield?
map.粗略比较股票 E/P 与无风险/信用债收益率，判断股债相对便宜。但盈利波动大、非: Roughly compare stock E/P with risk-free/credit-bond yields to judge equity-bond relative cheapness. But earnings are volatile and not fixed coupons, so it is only a reference.
map.周期股 PE 失真时 E/P 也失真？: When cyclical-stock P/E is distorted, is E/P also distorted?
map.是。周期顶点盈利高、E/P 虚高、PE 虚低，需用正常化盈利（周期平均）修正。: Yes. At the cycle peak earnings are high, E/P inflated and P/E deflated; use normalized (cycle-average) earnings to correct.
